name: Henri Veesaar
comment: Veesaar was diagnosed with a torn right ACL and is expected to miss the 2026-27 season, the Hawks announced Monday.

name: Mouhamed Gueye
comment: Gueye underwent surgery Tuesday to repair a fractured left foot that he suffered during a workout last week, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.

name: Keshon Gilbert
comment: Gilbert (hip) won't play in Saturday's Las Vegas Summer League game against the Wizards, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.

name: RayJ Dennis
comment: Dennis (Achilles) has been ruled out for Saturday's Summer League game against the Wizards, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.

name: Mikel Brown Jr.
comment: Brown (ankle) hasn't been cleared to practice with contact and remains without a timetable for a return, Brian Lewis of the New York Post reports.

name: Kon Knueppel
comment: Hornets general manager Jeff Peterson said Monday that he "doesn't know" whether Knueppel (hamstring) will be available for the team's regular-season opener against the Nets, Owen Watterson of SI.com reports.

name: Grant Williams
comment: Williams will miss the preseason after suffering a right hamstring injury, the Hornets announced Friday.

name: PJ Hall
comment: The Hornets announced Thursday that Hall underwent a procedure to address a fractured right ankle and will miss the remainder of the 2025-26 campaign.

name: Zach Collins
comment: Head coach Tiago Splitter said Monday that Collins (toe) is dealing with a soft tissue injury and isn't expected to practice Tuesday, K.C. Johnson of Chicago Sports Network reports.

name: Peyton Watson
comment: Although head coach Kenny Atkinson said the starting lineup for the beginning of the 2026-27 season is not yet set, he praised Watson's (hamstring) fit in Cleveland and added that "there's a lot of room for growth in his offensive game," Chris Fedor of Cleveland.com reports.

name: Morez Johnson Jr.
comment: Head coach Dusty May said Wednesday that Johnson has been limited in training camp due to lower-leg soreness, Ron Harrod Jr. of DLLS Sports reports.

name: Santi Aldama
comment: Aldama (undisclosed) was limited during Saturday's practice, Noah Weber of TheSmokingCuban.com reported.

name: Kyrie Irving
comment: Mavericks president Masai Ujiri offered an encouraging update on Irving's recovery Friday, saying the veteran guard is "right there" as he works toward returning to game action, Mike Curtis of The Dallas Morning News reports.

name: Dereck Lively II
comment: Mavericks president Masai Ujiri said Friday that Lively (foot) is "making good progress" in his recovery, Mike Curtis of The Dallas Morning News reports.

name: Trevon Brazile
comment: Brazile is out for Sunday's Summer League finale for undisclosed reasons, Ryan Blackburn of MileHighSports.com reports.

name: Kristaps Porzingis
comment: Porzingis is out indefinitely due to an undisclosed issue, Anthony Slater of ESPN.com reports.

name: Jimmy Butler III
comment: Butler has been cleared to participate in light on-court activities, Evan Webeck of the California Post reports.

name: Moses Moody
comment: Moody has progressed to light on-court activities as he continues his recovery from a ruptured left patellar tendon, Evan Webeck of The Mercury News reports.

name: Alex Toohey
comment: Toohey (knee) signed an Exhibit 10 contract with the Warriors on Wednesday, Anthony Slater of ESPN.com reports.

name: Larry Nance Jr.
comment: Pacers coach Rick Carlisle said Nance is limited to 5-on-0 work at training camp after suffering a hamstring injury just over two weeks ago, Tony East of Forbes.com reports.

name: Johnny Furphy
comment: Furphy was diagnosed with a torn right ACL on Monday and will miss the remainder of the season, Michael Scotto of USA Today reports.

name: Bradley Beal
comment: Beal (knee) will miss the start of training camp, Law Murray of The Athletic reports.

name: Yanic Konan Niederhauser
comment: Niederhauser (foot) won't be ready for the start of the season, Law Murray of The Athletic reports.

name: Brandon Ingram
comment: Ingram won't be ready for the start of the season due to a partially torn Achilles, per Joey Linn of SI.com.

name: Jordan Miller
comment: Miller underwent surgery Wednesday to repair a torn left rotator cuff and will be re-evaluated in six months, per Law Murray of The Athletic.

name: Micah Peavy
comment: General manager Zach Kleiman said Monday that Peavy recently turned his ankle and it'll be "some time" before the team gets a full look at him, Damichael Cole of The Memphis Commercial Appeal reports.

name: Zach Edey
comment: General manager Zach Kleiman said Monday that Edey (ankle/elbow) has been cleared for on-court activity and is on pace to suit up for Memphis' regular-season opener against the Jazz on Wednesday, Oct. 21, Chris Herrington of The Daily Memphian reports.

name: Karim Lopez
comment: Lopez (undisclosed) is out for Sunday's Summer League championship game against the Warriors, Drew Hill of The Daily Memphian reports.

name: Dru Smith
comment: Smith will miss a couple weeks with a strained right calf, Ira Winderman of the South Florida Sun Sentinel reports.

name: Myron Gardner
comment: Gardner (ankle) won't participate in the Las Vegas Summer League, per Ira Winderman of the South Florida Sun Sentinel.

name: Donte DiVincenzo
comment: Team president Tim Connelly believes DiVincenzo (Achilles) will return at some point this season, Jack Borman of the Locked On Wolves Podcast reports.

name: Bryce McGowens
comment: McGowens (toe) is out for Sunday's game against the Timberwolves.

name: Drew Eubanks
comment: Eubanks (thumb) agreed to a training camp contract with the Knicks on Tuesday, Ian Begley of SportsNet New York reports.

name: Mohamed Diawara
comment: Diawara (finger) didn't play in Friday's 110-88 Summer League loss to the Mavericks.

name: Thomas Sorber
comment: Sorber will be limited to begin training camp, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.

name: Nikola Topic
comment: Topic (back) will be limited when training camp begins, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports

name: Otega Oweh
comment: Oweh (lower leg) didn't play in Sunday's 108-90 Summer League loss to the Nets.

name: Noah Penda
comment: Penda tweaked his hamstring and is sidelined to begin training camp, according to Orlando Magic Daily.

name: Anthony Black
comment: Magic coach Sean Sweeney said Wednesday that Black is sidelined to begin training camp with a minor ankle sprain, according to Orlando Magic Daily.

name: Izaiyah Nelson
comment: Team president Jeff Weltman said Monday that Nelson (ankle) remains about a month away from returning to the court after offseason surgery, per Philip Rossman-Reich of OrlandoMagicDaily.com.

name: Jonathan Isaac
comment: Isaac (knee) said he will be limited to open training camp, according to Orlando Magic Daily.

name: Tacko Fall
comment: Fall was diagnosed with a left hip strain Thursday and will miss at least two weeks, Kyle Neubeck of AllPHLY.com reports.

name: Adem Bona
comment: 76ers coach Nick Nurse said Bona (foot) will be re-evaluated in a couple days, Tony Jones of The Athletic reports.

name: Duop Reath
comment: Reath (foot) agreed to a one-year veteran minimum contract with the Suns on Wednesday, John Gambadoro of Arizona Sports 98.7 FM reports.

name: Mark Williams
comment: Williams underwent surgery Thursday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will miss an extended period of time, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

name: CJ Huntley
comment: Huntley (hamstring) is out for Saturday's Las Vegas Summer League finale versus the Spurs, Duane Rankin of The Arizona Republic reports.

name: Shaedon Sharpe
comment: Sharpe suffered a torn meniscus in his knee and is expected to miss six months, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

name: David Jones Garcia
comment: Jones Garcia (ankle) agreed to a two-way contract with the Spurs on Wednesday, per Michael Scotto of HoopsHype.com.

name: Jayden Quaintance
comment: Quaintance underwent right knee surgery Wednesday and has no timetable for a return, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.

name: Jamison Battle
comment: Battle was held out of Thursday's scrimmage due to a lower back injury, Josh Lewenberg of TSN.ca reports.

name: Kyle Anderson
comment: Anderson sat out of Thursday's scrimmage due to a bruised right knee, Josh Lewenberg of TSN.ca reports.

name: Allen Graves
comment: Graves did not participate in the Raptors' scrimmage Thursday after tweaking his groin in practice, Josh Lewenberg of TSN.ca reports.

name: Nate Bittle
comment: Bittle (lower leg) was spotted in a walking boot Wednesday, Esfandiar Baraheni of The Athletic reports.

name: Alijah Martin
comment: Martin (knee) won't play in Sunday's Summer League game against the Nuggets, Zulfi Sheikh of Sportsnet reports.

name: Chucky Hepburn
comment: Hepburn (knee) won't play in Sunday's Summer League game against the Nuggets, Zulfi Sheikh of Sportsnet reports.

name: Trey Alexander
comment: Alexander (rib) is out for Friday's Summer League game against Portland, per Ben Anderson of KSL News Salt Lake City.

name: Tristan Vukcevic
comment: The Wizards announced Thursday that Vukcevic (hip) will be re-evaluated in four weeks.

name: Alex Sarr
comment: Sarr will be a partial participant when training camp begins as he continues his recovery from surgery to repair a fractured right foot,Josh Robbins of The Athletic reports.

name: Jamir Watkins
comment: The Wizards announced Thursday that Watkins has undergone surgery for a torn ACL.
